title: We are delighted, thank you Jesús
text:
Meeting up with Jesús was very easy, and the tour was magnificent.
He explains everything quite well and is always making sure that we are all together to listen and that we are not left with any questions. 
I thought it was a very beautiful experience full of a lot of information that helps you understand Granada.
Thanks also to the information he shared, you can continue visiting the rest of Granada, a total success.
